jobs.title: Business Transformation Advisory
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Do:
-
Strategic Deal Advisory : Support Sales Leaders and Account Executives on strategic deals as a Subject Matter Expert and trusted advisor. Provide perspectives on market / industry / functional trends, partner on deal strategy development and value-based discovery, and lead value analysis to create a compelling case for change.

-
Business Transformation Advisory : Engage with senior business leaders to understand their challenges, goals, and requirements. Leverage your deep industry knowledge and expertise to provide strategic advice and consultative support, demonstrating how Pigment's solutions can address their specific needs and drive business outcomes. Lead consultative engagements and workshops with customers and prospects to develop a roadmap toward their transformational planning vision.

-
Thought Leadership : Build credibility in the market as a thought leader on use of AI in Finance, business transformation, and business value. Act as a Subject Matter Expert in relevant webinars, conferences, panels, and networking events to highlight the business impact of our solutions and generate pipeline.

-
Go-To-Market Acceleration :  Champion value-based selling, support new sales plays, inform product strategy, and partner with regional leaders to identify expansion opportunities that grow NRR across the enterprise account base

-
Enablement at Scale : Empower internal teams to effectively position and sell Pigment's AI powered EPM solutions by evangelizing a value-based approach to selling. Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of self-service business value assets, including POV templates, industry thoughtware, ROI calculators, and value frameworks. Partner with Enablement to ensure sellers are equipped to utilize value assets effectively and at scale.
Who You Are:
-
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field required; advanced degree and/or professional certifications (e.g., MBA, CPA, CMA, CFA) preferred.

-
15+ years of progressive experience spanning Finance, Business Value Consulting, Management Consulting, Corporate Strategy, and/or Finance Transformation. Ideal candidates bring a combination of consulting or business value advisory experience alongside senior Finance leadership role.

-
Deep expertise in Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) and finance processes, including strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, performance management, and analytics. Experience deploying AI in Finance with an informed view of how AI will transform Finance.

-
Proven ability to assess complex business challenges, develop data-driven insights, and translate them into actionable recommendations that deliver measurable business outcomes.

-
Exceptional communication, storytelling, and executive presentation skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build credibility with stakeholders ranging from operational teams to C-suite executives.

-
Demonstrated success building trusted advisor relationships with customers and executive sponsors across all organizational levels. Established relationships within the CFO and Finance leadership community are highly desirable.

-
Strong strategic and commercial acumen, with the ability to align transformation initiatives to customer priorities, business objectives, and value realization outcomes.

-
Collaborative leadership style with a track record of partnering effectively across sales, product, marketing, customer success, and executive leadership teams.

-
Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed to engage with customers, support strategic initiatives, and represent the company at industry events.
What We Offer:
-
Competitive compensation package

-
Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth

-
Comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, & vision insurance coverage

-
We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies

-
Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, Toronto, Paris, and London

-
High-end equipment to do your work in the best conditions
How We Work
-
Thrive Together: We can only win as a team. We are all founders and do the right thing for our peers, Pigment customers, partners, and the planet

-
Never Settle: We aim to become the best at what we do by delivering with rigor and ambition every day. Delivering means building a passionate Pigment community

-
Go for it: We are biased towards action. Every action leads to learning and these learnings get us one step closer to our mission

-
Be real, be humble: We are generous with our feedback, open to change our views and we approach it with empathy knowing everyone is trying to do the best for Pigment
We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
 
Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

jobs.title: Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning
 
Pigment is the AI-powered business planning and performance management platform built for agility and scale. We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time.
 
Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario.
 
With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.


The opportunity
 
We are looking for an Engineering Program Manager (EPM) to help us scale our engineering team. Because we have EPMs almost since the beginning of Pigment, the role is already well-known. Our team is central to the engineering organization, perceived as a force multiplier by all the other engineers. We are constantly on the lookout to improve how we work. We like to try new ideas, whether it is to accelerate delivery, structure the organization or develop a unique culture. By joining our passionate, close-knitted team, you can have an impact in many different ways and learn in a team that is both young and fast-growing! 
Here is what the day-to-day of an EPM looks like at Pigment:
 
Deliver: You make a difference every day in the engineering team(s) you are working with, as you enhance clarity, direction, scope, and keep all the parts together with other roles (such as Product Managers). Typically an EPM accompanies 1 to 3 teams in their delivery, ranging from technical projects (e.g. scalability and performance, SRE) to more functional ones (e.g. bringing automations to our product).
 
Scale: You contribute to the engineering instances wherever you can bring added value. For instance, you can contribute to maintaining a healthy release pipeline, participate to incident response, oversee improvements to our monitoring and alerting practices…You also lead initiatives of various sizes to tackle the needs and issues that arise when growing as an organization. For instance, suggest evolutions to roles and responsibilities, better organize knowledge management, or work on large-scale projects related to quality management and production stability.
 
Federate: You contribute to the general well-being of the team, upon opportunity and based on affinity, for example as an organizer of regular instances (all-hands meetings, newsletters…), hackathons, team building activities, and any other idea related to the promotion of Pigment culture internally and externally. You also contribute to Pigment hiring and branding initiatives.
 
The team
As a team, we have a mission statement and a roadmap that we maintain over time. We are open to different styles and we rotate responsibilities and projects on a regular basis between us. We regularly exchange on our challenges in “co-development” sessions and sound new ideas to one another. You will also grow as an individual thanks to a career ladder and a culture of on-going feedback.
 
Explore Our Tech Blog:
If you're curious about the kind of challenges our engineering team tackles, our culture, and our organization, we invite you to explore our Tech Blog!
 
Who you are
 
We expect demonstrated experience in helping technical teams build and run in a fast-paced environment, with the right touch of processes and empowerment of individuals. 
 
Technical project/product management, engineering management, quality engineering, and production-related roles are typically the kind of roles where such an experience is demonstrated, but we are open to a diversity of backgrounds.
 
Experience as a software engineer is a plus but not required. The position does not involve coding. You should be able to read and understand code and read / comment / challenge a technical design.
 
To help you better understand the role, here are the qualities we are looking for in an EPM:
Resourcefulness: you like to be dropped in a new context and come up with your own solutions 
Change management: you are a people person and you convey change smartly and courageously
Diligence: you are curious and connect the dots in ways no one else can, you strive to reach alignment through shared understanding, clarity, and direction
Integrity: you lead by example, inspire others, and always play “first team”
 
The position doesn’t involve people management.
Fluency in English (French not required)
 
Folks from underrepresented minorities: science shows that you are less likely to apply if you feel that you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites. If this description matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply.
 
#LI-CK1

What you will get
 
- Competitive salary (70k to 100k)
- Equity
- The best health insurance with Alan Blue entirely free for you and your family 💙
- Trust and flexible working hours
- Brand new offices in the heart of Paris (Bourse), London, New York, and Toronto
- Remote-friendly environment


We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
 
Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

jobs.title: Global Employee Onboarding, Program Manager
jobs.description:

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software.
 
At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you.


The team
The GTM Enablement team empowers the Pigment ecosystem to win by simplifying complexity and delivering exceptional experiences. We help our go-to-market teams ramp faster, adapt quickly, and execute with confidence. Our vision: to enable the most in-demand GTM organization in the world, where top talent comes to do the best work of their careers, and does it.
Overseeing the curriculum, attendee experience, and overarching program facilitation of POP - the abbreviation for Pigment Onboarding Program - now sits within GTM Enablement. Recently redesigned from a fragmented, two-tier program into a consistent 3-day, remote-first experience run in parallel for EMEA and NAMER cohorts, POP is a first-class new hire program and one of the most visible expressions of Pigment's culture.
The role
We're hiring a Global Employee Onboarding, Program Manager to serve as the driving force behind repeatably executing the industry's leading standard for new hire onboarding. This role will operate in close partnership with Pigment's People team, who will largely support from a logistical coordination standpoint.
This role sits at the intersection of program operations and culture-building: you'll own the run-of-show for every cohort, keep EMEA and NAMER tracks running comparably and in parallel without collisions, coordinate a roster of internal facilitators, and continuously improve the experience against hard data — satisfaction, session engagement, content engagement, facilitator efficacy, social amplification, and a capstone AI competency assessment across Pigment's agentic tools.
You'll thrive in this role if you're a precise operator who can hold a lot of moving parts (facilitators, time zones, vendors, content) without dropping any of them, and if you know how to cultivate a great participant experience while making a program leaner and more scalable.
What you'll do
Own end-to-end delivery of POP for every cohort: scheduling, facilitator coordination, run-of-show management, logistics, and post-session measurement
Keep EMEA and NAMER cohorts running in parallel, managing the shared global anchor sessions (Founder Q&A, Closing Circle) and each region's distinct constraints (e.g.: EMEA's sequential regional benefits tracks; NAMER's 8am PST floor)
Coordinate in-person exceptions — e.g: R&D/Product new hires and any Paris-local hires attending in Paris — including stakeholder alignment with R&D leadership
Manage the facilitator roster and vendor relationships (e.g., regional benefits facilitators, LetterAI, swag/Sendoso vendor) and resolve open content items with their owners
Maintain and evolve the multi-day curriculum while supporting facilitator guides, timing constraints, and content pillars (“Why Anything?”, “Why Pigment?”, “Why Pigment Now?”) across in-person, hybrid, virtual, and asynchronous formats
Own measurement: satisfaction and engagement tracking, social media post growth, and the capstone AI competency assessment; turn results into a continuous improvement loop
Orchestrate monthly local hub socials (Austin, NYC, Toronto, San Francisco, London) that extend the onboarding experience for remote hires
Build clean, durable operating documentation so POP can run consistently without depending on any one person's institutional knowledge, and close the current gaps in post-onboarding handoff to managers
Partner with the People team, GTM leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders (R&D, Legal, Product Marketing, Finance and Professional Services) to keep content current and the program aligned to business priorities
Who you'll work with
You'll report into GTM Enablement leadership and work closely with:
The People team during program transition
Regional facilitators for benefits and culture sessions (e.g., UK, France, DACH tracks)
Thought leadership from across the company
R&D/Product stakeholders in Paris for Day 1 in-person sessions
People team and HRBPs, for probation and manager-accountability touchpoints
Vendors supporting swag and new hire experience logistics
Who you are
7-10 years in Enablement, People/L&D, program management, or an adjacent operational role, with a track record of owning a recurring program end-to-end
A strong program operator who thrives on detail: someone who tracks scheduling dependencies, facilitator counts, and time-zone constraints proactively rather than reactively
Comfortable running two parallel workstreams (EMEA/NAMER) all simultaneously incorporating regional nuance into each geo-specific delivery
A clear, concise verbal and written communicator across audiences — executive updates, facilitator coordination, and warm, participant-facing communications
Data-informed: comfortable turning feedback and assessment data into concrete program changes
Experienced with (or quick to learn) tools such as Google Docs/Drive, Excel, LMSs, HRIS (e.g.: HiBob) and feedback platforms (e.g.: Padlet)
Genuinely energized by new hire experience and culture-building, not just logistics
Nice to have
Experience running onboarding, enablement, or training programs across multiple regions/time zones
Familiarity with vendor management for swag/gifting platforms (e.g.: Sendoso)
Background in GTM Enablement, L&D, or People Operations at a high-growth SaaS company
Proven tracked record of optimizing efficiencies with AI tools
What success looks like
In your first 6–12 months, you will:
Take full, confident ownership of POP operations from the redesign team with no drop in quality
Run EMEA and NAMER cohorts in parallel smoothly, cohort after cohort, with tightening timing and fewer open items
Close out inherited open items (e.g., outstanding content placeholders, vendor decisions) and put durable owners and documentation in place
Show measurable improvement in satisfaction, engagement, and capstone AI competency assessment results
Strengthen the post-onboarding handoff to managers, improving manager accountability in the 30/45/90/120-day window
 
 

What we offer
- Competitive package

- Stock options to ensure you have a stake in Pigment's growth

- The best health insurance with Alan Blue, entirely free for you and your family

- Weekly Lunch and Lunch vouchers (Swile card) to cover your lunch breaks with total flexibility

- Subscription to Egym Wellpass (ex-Gymlib) for full access to gyms, studios, and wellness spaces across France

- A Learning Stipend per year, for you to develop into areas that amplify impact for your careers or personal development

- Remote work stipend to have the best work station possible at home

- Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, San Francisco, Toronto, Paris, and London

- High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions
Why Pigment
Pigment is building with ambition. We move quickly, think in systems, and care deeply about quality. You'll join a team that values clarity, curiosity, high standards, and real impact — and you'll own one of the most visible, highest-leverage moments in every new hire's journey at Pigment.
 
 


We conduct background checks as part of our hiring process, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. This may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally permitted, criminal records. Any checks will be conducted lawfully prior to formal employment contracts being signed, with candidate consent, and information will be treated confidentially.
 
Pigment is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diversity is a strength and fosters innovation. We are committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at the workplace.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability,  sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, social origin, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws. We may process your personal data in accordance with our HR Data Protection Notice.

jobs.title: Learning Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join Pigment: The AI Platform Redefining Business Planning

What You'll do:
Own Learning Operations and Program Delivery

- Manage the operational execution of customer and partner education programs at scale.

- Design and continuously improve operational workflows that reduce manual effort and increase program efficiency.

- Identify opportunities to automate learner communications, registrations, reminders, certifications, and reporting through AI-enabled workflows and platform automation.

- Evaluate emerging AI tools and capabilities that improve learner support, program administration, and operational scalability.

- Develop repeatable systems that allow education programs to grow without linear increases in administrative effort.

Drive Certification and Ecosystem Growth

- Support the growth and adoption of Pigment certification programs across customers and partners.

- Help develop certification pathways that support learner progression from foundational to advanced expertise.

- Partner with stakeholders to drive awareness, participation, and completion rates.

- Support train-the-trainer initiatives that expand Pigment's education delivery capacity.

- Contribute to the growth of the broader implementation talent ecosystem through scalable education programs.

- Leverage AI-assisted engagement strategies to improve learner activation, certification completion, and program participation.

- Use data and predictive insights to identify opportunities to improve learner progression through certification pathways.

- Experiment with AI-enabled approaches for talent ecosystem growth and readiness.

Own Learning Technology and Systems

- Serve as primary administrator for the LMS and supporting learning technologies.

- Design scalable learning operations that combine platform capabilities, workflow automation, and AI-driven processes.

- Build and maintain automations that reduce manual administration across enrollment, reporting, certifications, learner support, and content operations.

- Partner with internal teams to integrate learning systems with business systems and AI-enabled workflows.

- Evaluate and implement emerging AI capabilities that improve learning operations, personalization, content discoverability, and learner engagement.

- Maintain governance, data quality, security, and platform integrity while continuously improving operational efficiency.

Measure, Analyze, and Improve

- Use AI-powered analytics and reporting tools to identify trends in learner behavior, certification adoption, and program effectiveness.

- Develop dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across Customer Education, Partner Enablement, and Customer Experience.

- Leverage predictive and behavioral data to improve learner journeys and certification outcomes.

- Continuously identify opportunities where automation and AI can improve operational performance and learner experience.

AI and Automation Mindset

- Demonstrated experience leveraging AI, automation, or workflow orchestration tools to improve operational efficiency.

- Strong curiosity about emerging AI technologies and their application to learning, enablement, and program operations.

- Proven ability to identify manual processes and redesign them into scalable, automated workflows.

- Comfortable experimenting with new technologies and rapidly incorporating them into day-to-day operations.

- Experience with workflow automation platforms, AI copilots, or no-code automation tools is a strong advantage.
Who You Are: 
- 4+ years of experience in learning operations, education programs, certification management, enablement operations, or related fields

- Experience administering LMS platforms such as Docebo, Skilljar, Cornerstone, LearnUpon, or similar solutions

- Proven ability to manage cross-functional programs and operational workflows

- Experience supporting customer education, partner education, enablement, certification, or talent development initiatives

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data to improve adoption, engagement, and program outcomes

- Comfortable balancing strategic program goals with operational execution

- Excellent stakeholder management skills and ability to collaborate across Customer Education, Enablement, Customer Success, Product, and People teams

- Experience working in a high-growth SaaS environment preferred

- French and English fluent

jobs.title: Senior Sales Operations Manager, Americas
jobs.description:
About the Role
As the Americas Sales Operations Lead, you'll build and scale the operational engine powering our regional Sales organization. Reporting to the Global Head of Revenue Operations, you’ll partner closely with Americas Sales leadership to drive strategic planning, operational excellence, and data-driven decision making across the Americas revenue funnel — while coordinating with the global Revenue Operations team to ensure alignment on systems, processes, and reporting standards.

You will own core Sales Ops initiatives for the region including territory planning, forecasting support, pipeline management,and process optimization. This role requires a strategic operator who can balance close partnership with Americas leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York office.
What You'll Do
-
Serve as a trusted right hand to the Americas GM and an active member of the GTM Americas leadership team, providing operational insight that shapes regional strategy and decision-making

-
Partner with Americas Sales leadership to drive regional GTM strategy, territory design & planning, account prioritization, and performance optimization

-
Establish operational rigor around forecasting, pipeline management, KPI definition, reporting, and business reviews for the Americas region

-
Own and optimize sales processes and workflows (along with your cross regional counterparts), coordinating with the global GTM Systems team to ensure consistency and scalability

-
Serve as the Americas voice into global sales compensation structures, incentive programs, and SPIFF strategies

-
Drive adoption and standardization of Salesforce and core GTM tools within Americas, in close partnership with the global GTM Systems team.
Who You Are
-
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

-
5+ years of experience in B2B SaaS Revenue Operations or Sales Operations

-
Strong experience supporting Sales and BDR/SDR motions in a high-growth environment

-
Experience owning or partnering closely with Deal Desk operations

-
Deep expertise with Salesforce and core revenue systems

-
Comfort operating in a matrixed environment, partnering with regional leadership while coordinating with a global operations function

Nice to Have:

-
Experience with modern GTM tooling including Salesforce, Gong, and data enrichment platforms

-
Experience driving AI-enabled workflows and automation within Revenue Operations

-
Working knowledge of sales compensation design and GTM planning methodologies

-
French, German, or another European language proficiency is a plus
What We Offer
-
Competitive compensation package (Highly competitive base salary, equity package, and comprehensive benefits).

-
We encourage you to take the time you need. When you work hard, we know you also need to rest, which is why we offer generous time off and parental leave policies

-
Trust and flexible working hours

-
Along with one company offsite every year, we have brand new offices at the heart of major cities including New York, Toronto, Paris, London and San Francisco

-
High-end equipment (based on stock/availability) to do your work in the best conditions

-
Employer-sponsored 401(k), enabling you to prepare for retirement

-
Remote-friendly environment
